Technical SEO.title: Google Lighthouse Adds Audit For AI Agent Resource Discovery
Technical SEO.summary: Lighthouse 13.5 introduces an audit for AI agent resource discovery, though its checks differ from the latest ARD proposal. Enterprise SEOs should note the gap between tool output and the evolving specification when optimizing for AI crawlers.

Technical SEO.title: Job Boards Say Google Indexing API Requests Get No Response
Technical SEO.summary: Job site operators report months-long waits for Google Indexing API approval with no stated review timeframe in Google documentation, signaling a significant indexation bottleneck for large-scale content publishers relying on rapid URL submission.

Technical SEO.title: Google Analytics Adds Include Filters For Hostnames
Technical SEO.summary: Google Analytics now supports include-based data filters for hostnames, allowing properties to retain event data only from approved domains rather than blocking spam sources one by one. This is a meaningful quality-of-life improvement for enterprise setups managing multiple subdomains or international properties.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Research Shows Google AI Mode Sends Less Clicks and Is A Poor User Experience
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: New research indicates Google AI Mode decreases click-through to websites and delivers a poor user experience compared to standard search results. This has direct implications for enterprise teams forecasting organic traffic in industries where AI Mode surfaces are expanding.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: International SEO For Publishers: How To Succeed Across Borders
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that separate country-code domains are the more durable international strategy for most publishers, noting that a single dot-com approach works primarily for brands with significant authority such as The Guardian. Directly applicable for enterprise travel and cruise brands targeting multi-market audiences.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Agentic Commerce Is Not The Next Voice Shopping, But It Is Still Unproven
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: An analysis of agentic commerce claims finds that major payment platforms including Visa, Mastercard, PayPal, and Stripe name no live merchants, while Google names only three, highlighting that documented enterprise adoption remains extremely limited despite widespread announcements.

AI Search / GEO.title: How To Find The Sources Shaping AI Answers In Your Industry
AI Search / GEO.summary: Trendos analyst Gintare Rimolaityte outlines a methodology for mapping AI citation sources by industry and engine, identifying competitor gaps, and converting an audit into prioritized content and outreach actions. Directly actionable for enterprise GEO strategy across travel and automotive verticals.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media Studios analyzed over 13,000 citations across four major AI tools to identify which domains and content types are most frequently referenced in AI-generated answers. The dataset offers enterprise teams a benchmark for understanding which sources currently dominate AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: How To Build Local Pages AI Systems Can Find And Trust
AI Search / GEO.summary: Practical guidance from SEJ Live explains that AI systems rank passages, read alt text, and cite published data points, providing content structuring rules for local service pages intended to appear in AI answer surfaces. Relevant for travel and automotive brands with location-specific landing pages.

AI Search / GEO.title: Top Cited Domains Across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: LLM Pulse tracks which domains receive the most citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI, providing a comparative view of AI citation concentration by platform. Enterprise SEO and GEO teams can use this to identify authority gaps and link-building targets for AI visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: GEO, AEO, and SEO in 2026: The Enterprise Guide to AI Visibility
AI Search / GEO.summary: Writer published an enterprise-focused guide covering the intersection of generative engine optimization, answer engine optimization, and traditional SEO for AI visibility in 2026. Relevant as a strategic framework reference for enterprise teams building cross-channel AI search programs.
